acceptance: A valid refund is accepted and adds exactly its amount and one settled effect.
rejection: An invalid refund is rejected with IllegalArgumentException and changes neither observation.
non_vacuity: Accept a positive partial refund; reach the cap; reject invalid requests without changing state.
scope: One capture, one currency, sequential in-memory calls; no retries, persistence, provider or concurrency.
authority: Local experiment expectation specified by behavior-counterexample-plan milestones 1 and 2; not trusted CI policy.
